scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-southern-battery-no-2-historical-.story: A 148 km round trip from Kronstadt - roughly 2 h 33 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ropshinskoe Highway, Dudergof, Historical Centre of the Town of Pavlovsk and back through Dudergof. The line favours views over speed.
